description: This Java interface defines metrics for COAP-based adapters within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes a nested class implementing a no-op version of the metrics, as well as a singleton instance of that no-op implementation.

classes.name: CoapAdapterMetrics
classes.description: An interface extending Metrics, specific to COAP adapter metrics, with a nested class providing a no-op implementation.

classes.name: CoapAdapterMetrics.Noop
classes.description: A final class implementing CoapAdapterMetrics and extending NoopBasedMetrics, serving as a no-operation placeholder.

methods.name: Noop
methods.description: Private constructor for the Noop class, preventing instantiation from outside.
